list.title: Paper job status
list.description: Browse backend-owned durable state in API order. Status changes appear only after an explicit command or manual refresh.
list.emptyTitle: No paper jobs match this filter
list.emptyMessage: The product database request succeeded and returned no durable jobs for the selected status.

detail.acceptedEyebrow: Accepted Run response · Awaiting manual refresh
detail.staleDescription: Refresh status is required before another action can be selected.
detail.resultBoundary: Result inspection is offered only from the backend-owned availability flag. This page never follows the returned result URL or loads result contents automatically.
detail.acceptedDescription: Run was accepted, not completed. Use Refresh status before selecting any mutation.
detail.noControl: No mutating control is available for a {status} job.
detail.oneCommand: Job {jobId}. This sends one command only.
detail.runConfirmation: Accepted execution still requires manual refresh to observe claim or completion.
detail.retryConfirmation: Retry returns a failed job to queued and does not run it.
detail.staleGuidance: Supply the exact UTC threshold; the browser never generates one silently.
detail.staleError: Enter a full UTC date and time ending in Z or +00:00.
detail.runSuccess: Execution was accepted, not completed. Use Refresh status manually to observe later state.
detail.retrySuccess: The failed job returned to queued. It has not run; use the separate Run action when ready.
detail.recoverSuccess: Recovery inspection returned the current backend status: {status}. No further action was chained.
detail.cancelSuccess: The queued job was canceled. Nothing was run.
detail.attemptsBoundary: Order and approved error codes come from the backend.
detail.emptyAttempts: The attempts request succeeded. No attempts exist for this job.
detail.relatedDescription: Choose two to four backend-available results. No ranking or recommendation is produced.

submission.title: Submit a queued job
submission.description: Submission creates or exactly replays durable queued state. It never runs the job; Run remains a separate confirmed action on the detail page.
submission.demoDescription: Available in Demo Workspace mode. Values come only from the validated backend descriptor, and nothing is submitted automatically.
submission.demoStart: Start the isolated Demo Workspace before loading this example.
submission.demoLoadFailed: The Demo descriptor could not be loaded.
submission.attentionDescription: Correct the associated required or numeric fields before sending.
submission.identityDescription: Identify the backend request. Required values are sent exactly as entered.
submission.runGuidance: Use a normalized nonblank run identity.
submission.timestampGuidance: Use an explicit UTC timestamp ending in Z or +00:00.
submission.idempotencyGuidance: Provides replay-safe submission identity. It is not a password or job ID. Exact replay and conflicts remain backend-owned.
submission.accountDescription: Enter backend transport fields exactly; no account values are derived in the browser.
submission.nonNegativeGuidance: Use a finite non-negative decimal number.
submission.ordersDescription: Orders are optional. When added, every field is required; timestamps use explicit UTC, quantities use positive finite decimals, and rows are sent in the exact order shown.
submission.fillsDescription: Fills are optional. Added timestamps use explicit UTC; quantity is a positive finite decimal and price is a finite non-negative decimal. Blank optional order ID is sent as null, and row order is preserved.
submission.executionBoundary: Execution will not start from this form.
submission.nonNegativeError: Enter a finite non-negative decimal number.
submission.positiveError: Enter a positive finite decimal number.
submission.duplicateSymbolError: Duplicate position symbols are not allowed in one account state.
